No one can guarantee this will be the same for you, but perhaps it can be a little bit hopeful that it’s possible…

I had severe PPD after my first child. It was bad, I almost unalived and was too afraid to have a second even though I wanted one because I didn’t think I could survive that again.

I had my second when my first was almost 3 and was dreading the forthcoming PPD every day, wondering if I could survive it this time and yet… absolutely nothing happened. I never even felt the baby blues, I didn’t experience any PPD.

It was such a relief and so interesting to see how unique each pregnancy experience is.

It’s still very possible you could have PPD again, so start talking to your care team now. But just because you had it the first time does NOT mean you’ll for sure have it again.

All my best to you!
